title: The Wedding and the Culinary Duel

scenes.title: Viktor Petrovich's Return
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov returns from the hospital and is shocked to find that Eleonora hired a new head chef.

scenes.title: Challenge to a Culinary Duel
scenes.summary: Furious that his cooks were fired, Chef Barinov challenges the new chef to a cook-off, and Eleonora agrees.

scenes.title: A Princess Before the Wedding
scenes.summary: Eleonora compliments Katya's wedding dress and mentions the new investor who saved her from bankruptcy.

scenes.title: An Offer to Run Away Together
scenes.summary: Denis sneaks into Katya's room to apologize and begs her to run away with him before the wedding.

scenes.title: Battle for Their Kitchen
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov rallies his fired cooks to defeat Anton's crew in a thirty-minute culinary duel.

scenes.title: Gulya's Farewell and a Brawl
scenes.summary: Gulya tells Lyova she is moving back to Bishkek forever, causing chaos that forfeits the kitchen duel.

scenes.title: Gulya's Lie and the Bachelorette Party
scenes.summary: Gulya claims she is having an arranged marriage in Bishkek, while Nastya heads off to Katya's bachelorette party.

scenes.title: The Plan to Steal the Dress
scenes.summary: Kostya and Denis plot to steal Katya's wedding dress, while Sveta offers Katya and Nastya a ride home.

scenes.title: Confession in the Car
scenes.summary: In Sveta's car, Katya confesses to Nastya that she cheated on Nikita with Denis on the day of his proposal.

scenes.title: The Morning After Stealing the Dress
scenes.summary: Kostya and Denis wake up hungover and realize they actually stole Katya's wedding dress during the night.

scenes.title: Returning the Wedding Dress
scenes.summary: Denis returns the stolen wedding dress to Katya and wishes her and Nikita happiness.

scenes.title: Sveta's Blackmail and the Tasting
scenes.summary: Sveta threatens to send the wedding guests the video of Katya's confession, while Chef Barinov criticizes the new kitchen crew.

scenes.title: The New Chef Walks Out
scenes.summary: Driven crazy by Chef Barinov's constant meddling before Katya's wedding, Anton quits and walks out with his cooks.

scenes.title: Senya's Stash and a Trap for Denis
scenes.summary: Senya saves the wedding banquet with his stolen food stash, while Denis tries to get Sveta to delete the dashcam video.

scenes.title: Advice Before the Altar
scenes.summary: Mikhail brings extra food for the banquet, and Elena advises Katya to look into Nikita's eyes at the altar.

scenes.title: The Wedding Is Called Off
scenes.summary: At the altar, Katya realizes she cannot marry Nikita without love and calls off the wedding.

scenes.title: Viktor Petrovich's Proposal
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov proposes to Elena Pavlovna on the spot, and the officiant pronounces them husband and wife.

scenes.title: The Truth About Gulya
scenes.summary: Ainura tells Lyova that Gulya lied about the arranged marriage because her migration card expired, and urges him to go to the airport.

scenes.title: Lyova's Choice
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov names Lyova the new head chef of the restaurant, but Lyova leaves for Bishkek to be with Gulya.

scenes.title: Who Is Kostya's Father
scenes.summary: Kostya's grandmother looks at a photo of the man Nastya found and declares he is not Kostya's father.
